The '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[NPC]] [[vendor]]. He is located at the [[Sealight Lighthouse]]. He trades products related to [[fishing]].

==Quests==
===Fish Dishes===
Ask him how to prepare fish and he will tell you recipes of some [[Cookery (Tech Tree)|fish dishes]].

===Fishing Rod===
Bring the {{PAGENAME}} {{item|Moth|6}} in exchange for a {{item|simple fishing rod}}. 

===Necronomicon===
The [[Astrologer]] tells you, that he gave the {{item|Necronomicon}} to his friend, the Lighthouse Keeper. If you ask him about it, he'll give it to you for {{item|Maggot|5}}.

==Trading==
===Selling===
*The cost of fishing rods and lures do not inflate.

===Purchasing===
*Will not buy back either lure, any fish fillets, or the [[Excellent fishing rod|excellent rod]].
*Will not buy any insect-bait, despite having an apparent interest in both the [[moth]] and [[maggot]].
*Selling crucians is ill-advised, as the precious metals gained from processing them are much more valuable.
*Selling [[goldfish]] is particularly profitable; as odds are to catch one fish per two best lures when fishing in the night, the average net profit is {{Money|2750}} plus {{Item|Tuna|19}}.
